FX-GLUE-001.says: As added, the brush never keyed at the middle: Stroke Width 20, Density 5, Time Span 1, Reflection 50, Strength 50, lit as Blobbylize is: one round glossy blob over the whole drawing, the same at frame 4 (more blobs on the same spot pile up but reach no further), on the grey ramp.

FX-GLUE-002.says: The sweep, unlit, Reflection 0: at frame 0 a single blob at the left, at frame 2 a stroke half way across, at frame 4 the whole stroke, 4 pixels wide, the photo beneath it at half brightness.
